project.name: C-04 UI/使用性テスト計画 v1（取込）
project.purpose: 事前固定したUI/使用性/上下遷移/操作効率の受入計画をPlaywright実機で登録・実行する
project.rules: 結果確認後に合格基準を緩めない。承認・完了状態を推測変更しない。
project.focus: Mobile 390x844 / Desktop 1440x1000、ページ遷移・上下遷移・クリック効率・保存削除reload
project.next: 登録済み計画と同一基準でPlaywright E2Eを実行しFAILをUI改善へ返す

items.title: Vertical traversal efficiency
items.body:
Actions
[
  "from top controls open 項目",
  "inspect from first visible item toward the last item",
  "return to primary controls",
  "inspect lower overview/approval content"
]

Pass
[
  "per-task vertical direction reversals <= 1",
  "mobile total direction reversals <= 3",
  "desktop total direction reversals <= 2",
  "down-up-down or up-down-up oscillation for one objective = 0",
  "no return by >= one viewport followed by re-traversal toward the same target",
  "scroll targets are not hidden under fixed overlays"
]
